name: Late safety car, rain, and a mandatory stop
description: A worked ScenarioScript for the race director (src/rtv/director). It rehearses the one race a strategist is worst at: a full-course yellow, weather that turns the tyre call over, and a regulation change that removes the option of staying out. The director runs only from the eval path: evals/run_director.py walks it with ScriptedDirector over the synthetic director race or a stored session, and writes its own journal outside data/sessions. In the app, RTV_PITWALL_DIRECTOR_SCRIPT only validates it (NoopDirector). Loading it validates it: ScenarioScript.load('docs/director_scenario.example.json').

injections.note: Full-course yellow a third of the way round lap 3. Payload keys are the real detector's keys, so the strategist's flag_change trigger and the spotter's both fire exactly as they would for a yellow the sim threw.
Ninety session-seconds of caution, then the restart. Session seconds, not wall clock: a 4x replay must rehearse the same race.

weather_change is a director-only event type; it wakes the strategist and the vehicle engineer: no iRacing channel announces rain that has not arrived, so nothing deterministic can emit it (see rtv.racestate.models.EventType). Guarded by while_flag so it does not land during the caution, where nobody could react to it.

Forced pit regulation: the stop is no longer optional, so 'extend' and 'stay_out' stop being defensible answers and the strategist's decision band changes. This is the entry that makes the script worth running against an eval set. It wakes the strategist, which revises the race plan through propose_plan_revision, checked against this payload's laps.

A hazard expressed with an existing detector event type (the traffic detector's payload keys) rather than a new one. It reaches the driver through the spotter's B2 template, not an LLM call, which is the whole argument for the director producing ordinary events. Car 1 is in the synthetic field; a replayed .ibt has no field at all, which the rehearsal report says.
